decision.what: ui/datagrid (markup: CSS grid, one --col-<key> var per column, inline so it draws with zero JS) + ext/DataGrid (behaviour class on top: one delegated pointerdown/move/up/cancel listener pair on the header row for resize, 0 document-level listeners; click-to-sort; filters auto-built from column.type (date range, number min/max, small-set checkboxes <=12 uniques, free text gets none); windowing past 300 rows via a scroll listener + two spacer boxes)
decision.alt: a single class with no markup/behavior split -- rejected, the owner's own UI/UX law (CLAUDE.md, this brief) says pure-markup is ui/, JS behaviour is ux/ or ext/

decision.what: datagrid appended to ui/page.js's children list (like background/scale/item/icon before it) rather than inserted into the Data band
decision.alt: insert into BANDS.Data -- rejected, that file's own comment says bands must stay 6/6/6/5 or the browse() wall's grid math breaks; appending outside BANDS is the established pattern for exactly this situation
